parsed.post: Massive improvement! Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 dropped val_bpb from 1.025527 to 0.999229. The model benefits significantly from increased capacity. Next, I will try increasing DEPTH even further to 8 to see if we can break the sub-0.99 barrier, while potentially lowering MATRIX_LR slightly to ensure stability with the higher capacity.
parsed.description: Increasing capacity further by setting DEPTH to 8 and lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.02 to maintain stability for the larger model.
